VALUE.name: VALUE
VALUE.description: Converts a string in any of the date, time or number formats that Google Sheets understands into a number. Learn more

DAVERAGE.name: DAVERAGE
DAVERAGE.description: Returns the average of a set of values selected from a database table-like array or range using a SQL-like query. Learn more

DCOUNT.name: DCOUNT
DCOUNT.description: Counts numeric values selected from a database table-like array or range using a SQL-like query. Learn more

DCOUNTA.name: DCOUNTA
DCOUNTA.description: Counts values, including text, selected from a database table-like array or range using a SQL-like query. Learn more

DGET.name: DGET
DGET.description: Returns a single value from a database table-like array or range using a SQL-like query. Learn more

DMAX.name: DMAX
DMAX.description: Returns the maximum value selected from a database table-like array or range using a SQL-like query. Learn more

DMIN.name: DMIN
DMIN.description: Returns the minimum value selected from a database table-like array or range using a SQL-like query. Learn more

DPRODUCT.name: DPRODUCT
DPRODUCT.description: Returns the product of values selected from a database table-like array or range using a SQL-like query. Learn more

DSTDEV.name: DSTDEV
DSTDEV.description: Returns the standard deviation of a population sample selected from a database table-like array or range using a SQL-like query. Learn more

DSTDEVP.name: DSTDEVP
DSTDEVP.description: Returns the standard deviation of an entire population selected from a database table-like array or range using a SQL-like query. Learn more

DSUM.name: DSUM
DSUM.description: Returns the sum of values selected from a database table-like array or range using a SQL-like query. Learn more

DVAR.name: DVAR
DVAR.description: Returns the variance of a population sample selected from a database table-like array or range using a SQL-like query. Learn more

DVARP.name: DVARP
DVARP.description: Returns the variance of an entire population selected from a database table-like array or range using a SQL-like query. Learn more

CONVERT.name: CONVERT
CONVERT.description: Converts a numeric value to a different unit of measure. Learn more

TO_DATE.name: TO_DATE
TO_DATE.description: Converts a provided number to a date. Learn more

TO_DOLLARS.name: TO_DOLLARS
TO_DOLLARS.description: Converts a provided number to a dollar value. Learn more

TO_PERCENT.name: TO_PERCENT
TO_PERCENT.description: Converts a provided number to a percentage. Learn more

TO_PURE_NUMBER.name: TO_PURE_NUMBER
TO_PURE_NUMBER.description: Converts a provided date/time, percentage, currency or other formatted numeric value to a pure number without formatting. Learn more

TO_TEXT.name: TO_TEXT
TO_TEXT.description: Converts a provided numeric value to a text value. Learn more

ARRAY_CONSTRAIN.name: ARRAY_CONSTRAIN
ARRAY_CONSTRAIN.description: Constrains an array result to a specified size. Learn more

BYCOL.name: BYCOL
BYCOL.description: Groups an array by columns by application of a LAMBDA function to each column. Learn more

BYROW.name: BYROW
BYROW.description: Groups an array by rows by application of a LAMBDA function to each row. Learn more

CHOOSECOLS.name: CHOOSECOLS
CHOOSECOLS.description: Creates a new array from the selected columns in the existing range. Learn more

CHOOSEROWS.name: CHOOSEROWS
CHOOSEROWS.description: Creates a new array from the selected rows in the existing range. Learn more

FLATTEN.name: FLATTEN
FLATTEN.description: Flattens all the values from one or more ranges into a single column. Learn more

FREQUENCY.name: FREQUENCY
FREQUENCY.description: Calculates the frequency distribution of a one-column array into specified classes. Learn more

GROWTH.name: GROWTH
GROWTH.description: Given partial data about an exponential growth trend, fits an ideal exponential growth trend and/or predicts further values. Learn more

HSTACK.name: HSTACK
HSTACK.description: Appends ranges horizontally and in sequence to return a larger array. Learn more

LINEST.name: LINEST
LINEST.description: Given partial data about a linear trend, calculates various parameters about the ideal linear trend using the least-squares method. Learn more

LOGEST.name: LOGEST
LOGEST.description: Given partial data about an exponential growth curve, calculates various parameters about the best fit ideal exponential growth curve. Learn more

MAKEARRAY.name: MAKEARRAY
MAKEARRAY.description: Returns an array of specified dimensions with values calculated by application of a LAMBDA function. Learn more

MAP.name: MAP
MAP.description: Maps each value in the given arrays to a new value by application of a LAMBDA function to each value. Learn more

MDETERM.name: MDETERM
MDETERM.description: Returns the matrix determinant of a square matrix specified as an array or range. Learn more

MINVERSE.name: MINVERSE
MINVERSE.description: Returns the multiplicative inverse of a square matrix specified as an array or range. Learn more

MMULT.name: MMULT
MMULT.description: Calculates the matrix product of two matrices specified as arrays or ranges. Learn more

REDUCE.name: REDUCE
REDUCE.description: Reduces an array to an accumulated result by application of a LAMBDA function to each value. Learn more

SCAN.name: SCAN
SCAN.description: Scans an array and produces intermediate values by application of a LAMBDA function to each value. Returns an array of the intermediate values obtained at each step. Learn more

SUMPRODUCT.name: SUMPRODUCT
SUMPRODUCT.description: Calculates the sum of the products of corresponding entries in two equal-sized arrays or ranges. Learn more

SUMX2MY2.name: SUMX2MY2
SUMX2MY2.description: Calculates the sum of the differences of the squares of values in two arrays. Learn more

SUMX2PY2.name: SUMX2PY2
SUMX2PY2.description: Calculates the sum of the sums of the squares of values in two arrays. Learn more

SUMXMY2.name: SUMXMY2
SUMXMY2.description: Calculates the sum of the squares of differences of values in two arrays. Learn more

TOCOL.name: TOCOL
TOCOL.description: Transforms an array or range of cells into a single column. Learn more

TOROW.name: TOROW
TOROW.description: Transforms an array or range of cells into a single row. Learn more

TRANSPOSE.name: TRANSPOSE
TRANSPOSE.description: Transposes the rows and columns of an array or range of cells. Learn more

TREND.name: TREND
TREND.description: Given partial data about a linear trend, fits an ideal linear trend using the least squares method and/or predicts further values. Learn more

VSTACK.name: VSTACK
VSTACK.description: Appends ranges vertically and in sequence to return a larger array. Learn more

WRAPCOLS.name: WRAPCOLS
WRAPCOLS.description: Wraps the provided row or column of cells by columns after a specified number of elements to form a new array. Learn more

WRAPROWS.name: WRAPROWS
WRAPROWS.description: Wraps the provided row or column of cells by rows after a specified number of elements to form a new array. Learn more

ENCODEURL.name: ENCODEURL
ENCODEURL.description: Encodes a string of text for the purpose of using in a URL query. Learn more.

HYPERLINK.name: HYPERLINK
HYPERLINK.description: Creates a hyperlink inside a cell. Learn more

IMPORTDATA.name: IMPORTDATA
IMPORTDATA.description: Imports data at a given url in .csv (comma-separated value) or .tsv (tab-separated value) format. Learn more

IMPORTFEED.name: IMPORTFEED
IMPORTFEED.description: Imports a RSS or ATOM feed. Learn more

IMPORTHTML.name: IMPORTHTML
IMPORTHTML.description: Imports data from a table or list within an HTML page. Learn more

IMPORTRANGE.name: IMPORTRANGE
IMPORTRANGE.description: Imports a range of cells from a specified spreadsheet. Learn more

IMPORTXML.name: IMPORTXML
IMPORTXML.description: Imports data from any of various structured data types including XML, HTML, CSV, TSV, and RSS and ATOM XML feeds. Learn more

ISURL.name: ISURL
ISURL.description: Checks whether a value is a valid URL. Learn more

AI.name: AI
AI.description: Generates text, summarizes information, categorizes information, and accesses real-time information. Learn moreThis function is a Google Workspace with Gemini feature
